# specious

> based on pretense; deceptively pleasing Almost every image on TV is specious and not to be trusted.

> plausible but false.

> Seemingly true but actually false; deceptively attractive

> seemingly reasonable but actually wrong


## Example

- *He made a career out of specious arguments and fictional lab results, but lost his job and reputation when his lies were exposed by an article in The New York Times.*
